entities.summary: Louis Le Vau was a French Baroque architect, who worked for King Louis XIV, the Sun King. Contemporary of both François Mansart and Jacques Lemercier, Louis Le Vau was one of the founders of the French Classical style in the 17th century, skillfully blending it with Baroque influences.
